method.detail: Executable shared-backbone workflow; see method-specific evidence and adaptations.

model.detail: Shared comparison backbone replaces each original generator; model id must match the serving endpoint.

retriever.detail: Shared BGE candidate collection and local dense ranking replace the original retrieval service; corpus scope is provided by the runner.

top_k.detail: process_sub_question queries ten documents; also Appendix A of the paper.

max_steps.detail: Execute at most eight planned sub-questions; official code executes the entire generated list without a numerical bound.

seeds.detail: Shared protocol seeds; applied to every method.

base_documents.detail: EK_recaller keeps first two documents unconditionally, then appends matches.

keyword_count.detail: Figure 5: extract one or two distinctive single-word keywords. This implementation uses Qwen for keyword extraction.

keyword_case_sensitive.detail: EK_recaller uses all(keyword in doc[contents] for keyword in EK_list), a literal case-sensitive AND filter.

keyword_max_tokens.detail: 128 output tokens for the adapted Qwen keyword JSON; original uses a trained Llama-3.2-3B extractor.
